name.description: Agent id; must match the file name.

description.description: When to use this agent. Both runtimes show it to pick the agent.

stage.description: SDLC stage 1-8: 1 Backlog & Plan, 2 Code, 3 Review & Secure, 4 Build & Test, 5 Release & Deploy, 6 Run & Observe, 7 User Feedback, 8 Learn & Re-prioritise.

skills.description: Skills the agent loads; each must exist under skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

tools.description: Runtime-neutral tool groups; kit-sync maps them to Copilot and Claude Code names.

mcp.description: MCP servers the agent uses; each must exist as mcp/<name>.json.

permissions.description: GITHUB_TOKEN scopes for the agent's workflow. Omitted scopes are none.

human_gate.description: Who confirms the agent's output before it takes effect (ADR-0007, ADR-0014).

mode.description: v0.1 ships propose-only: comments, draft PRs, proposed rollbacks. Wider modes come per stage on agent-quality evidence.

reviewer.description: Role that confirms, e.g. CODEOWNER, product owner, on-call.

evidence.description: What the agent leaves behind per trigger; the agent-evidence step marks it so ASTRAL can count it.

kind.description: Output: a comment on the Issue or PR, a draft PR, an Issue or a draft release.

label.description: Agent label from policies/labels.json; put on PR and Issue outputs to attribute them.

trigger.description: The trigger the output answers; one of triggers.
